title: Senior Scientist I, Computational Biology & Machine Learning

cond_0001.intro: We are looking for a Senior Scientist I, Computational Biology & Machine Learning to join our team. You will work closely with an interdisciplinary team of scientists and engineers to develop algorithms, models, and computational workflows to analyze large amounts of data from a variety of technologies. By addressing challenging problems in synthetic and molecular biology, immunology, and high throughput assays, you will meaningfully contribute to accelerating the development of curative cell therapies against cancer and will have a direct impact on patients' lives.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Develop machine learning / deep learning models to extract insights from large screening experiments.
Analyze data from next generation sequencing assays (eg. RNA-seq, single-cell RNA-seq, ATAC-seq), flow cytometry, or other related technologies.
Work closely with [Company name masked] scientists across different functions and disciplines to rapidly iterate through the cycle of experimental design, hypothesis testing, data collection, and interpretation.
Assist with experimental design, for example through modeling or simulations.
Help productionize computational workflows so that they can be executed in a robust and reproducible manner.
Develop visualization tools.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Ph.D. In Bioinformatics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Statistics, Biomedical Engineering, Biology, or a related field with 2+ years of industry experience, OR Masters with 7+ years of industry experience, OR Bachelors with 9+ years of industry experience.
Demonstrated ability to apply data analysis and engineering skills to answer biological questions.
Hands-on experience analyzing next generation sequencing data.
Hands-on experience developing deep learning models.
Ability to work collaboratively and communicate effectively in an interdisciplinary environment.
Proficiency in Python.
Preferred Requirements
Experience working in Linux environments.
Familiarity with cloud computing environments and version control systems (eg. Git).
Familiarity with cell therapy or immunotherapy.

By addressing challenging problems in synthetic and molecular biology, immunology, and high throughput assays, you will meaningfully contribute to accelerating the development of curative cell therapies against cancer and will have a direct impact on patients' lives.
cond_0218.responsibilities:
Develop machine learning / deep learning models to extract insights from large screening experiments.
Analyze data from next generation sequencing assays (eg. RNA-seq, single-cell RNA-seq, ATAC-seq), flow cytometry, or other related technologies.
Work closely with [Company name masked] scientists across different functions and disciplines to rapidly iterate through the cycle of experimental design, hypothesis testing, data collection, and interpretation.
Assist with experimental design, for example through modeling or simulations.
Help productionize computational workflows so that they can be executed in a robust and reproducible manner.
Develop visualization tools.
cond_0218.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Ph.D. In Bioinformatics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Statistics, Biomedical Engineering, Biology, or a related field with a minimum of 2 years of demonstrated industry expertise, OR Master's degree with a minimum of 7 years of demonstrated industry expertise, OR Bachelor's degree with a minimum of 9 years of demonstrated industry expertise; advanced degree strongly preferred.
Proven track record of applying data analysis and engineering skills to answer biological questions.
Extensive hands-on expertise analyzing next generation sequencing data.
Substantial hands-on expertise developing deep learning models.
Exceptional communication skills and ability to work collaboratively in an interdisciplinary environment.
Deep knowledge of Python.
Strong command of Linux environments.
Preferred Requirements
Proficiency in cloud computing environments and version control systems (eg. Git).
Solid understanding of cell therapy or immunotherapy.

By addressing challenging problems in synthetic and molecular biology, immunology, and high throughput assays, you will meaningfully contribute to accelerating the development of curative cell therapies against cancer and will have a direct impact on patients' lives. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of biological data and how computational approaches can be applied to it.
cond_0256.responsibilities:
Develop machine learning / deep learning models to extract insights from large screening experiments.
Analyze data from next generation sequencing assays (eg. RNA-seq, single-cell RNA-seq, ATAC-seq), flow cytometry, or other related technologies.
Work closely with [Company name masked] scientists across different functions and disciplines to rapidly iterate through the cycle of experimental design, hypothesis testing, data collection, and interpretation.
Assist with experimental design, for example through modeling or simulations.
Help productionize computational workflows so that they can be executed in a robust and reproducible manner.
Develop visualization tools.
cond_0256.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
Ph.D. In Bioinformatics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Statistics, Biomedical Engineering, Biology, or a related field with 2+ years of industry experience, OR Masters with 7+ years of industry experience, OR Bachelors with 9+ years of industry experience.

Hands-on experience analyzing next generation sequencing data.
Hands-on experience developing deep learning models.
Proficiency in Python.
Ability to work collaboratively and communicate effectively in an interdisciplinary environment.

Experience working in Linux environments.
Familiarity with cloud computing environments and version control systems (eg. Git).
